title: feat(cut2site): N_cut2=4 F_cut fillers from 2-site face-diagonal
science: A genuine seed-dependence result with an exact subcube characterization. From the face-diagonal 2-site seed {(0,0,0),(1,1,0)}, N_cut2=4 of the 32 F_cut maps fill, and the filler set is characterized exactly: fills iff wt1=adj2=vertex3=1, with (opp2, mixed3) free.
